note: a complete post-mortem: every required part is present

sections.text: p99 went from 180ms to 410ms in the week after we shipped the read-through cache. p50 barely moved, 42ms to 39ms.
Roughly 9,000 checkout requests a day took over a second. Support saw 40 tickets about the cart hanging.
A miss under load is more expensive than having no cache at all: you pay for the lookup, then you pay the origin anyway.
The 30 second TTL meant the hot query expired during every traffic peak, so peaks were exactly when the cache stopped helping.
Redis was healthy the entire time. Memory fine, CPU fine, every dashboard green. That is why it took four days to find.
We moved to a stale-while-revalidate read and raised the TTL to ten minutes. Live since Tuesday.
We now alert on p99 by route rather than on the service average, which is what would have caught this on day one.
